label: Perimeter
description: External boundary — fence line, parking approach, loading dock exterior.

label: Entry Point
description: Doors, turnstiles, visitor reception — primary access control boundary.

label: Public Area
description: Lobby, cafeteria, conference — low restriction internal space.

label: Restricted
description: Badge-required areas — operations floor, back office.

label: Secure Vault
description: High-value target — vault, archive, sensitive records.

label: RF Enclosure
description: Wireless trust boundary — Faraday space, SCIF-adjacent, lab.

label: Executive Suite
description: C-suite, boardroom — high-value identity and document targets.

label: Utility / Mechanical
description: Mechanical rooms, roof access, service corridors.
